page_title: LEC 0-2 INT | Lecce v Inter 21/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' The foul by Lameck Banda (Lecce) was seen by Gianluca Manganiello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.
88' Substitution. Alessandro Bastoni leaves the pitch and is replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
87' What was Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
86' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.
83' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikola Stulic (Lecce) replacing Lassana Coulibaly.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Santiago Pierotti departs the field of play to be replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
82' 0 - 2 The corner from Federico Dimarco goes into a dangerous area and finds Manuel Akanji (Inter), who outjumps the defence and glances a header into the back of the net. 0:2.
81' Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
80' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lecce was in an offside position.
80' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is obviously very disappointed with his shot from the rebound. He aims exactly at the goalkeeper's gloves. This should have been an easy goal!
75' 0 - 1 Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) perfectly latches on to a cross from the corner kick and blasts the ball into the bottom right corner. What a goal!
75' Corner kick. Inter will have an opportunity.
74' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Lecce for a penalty. Play continues.
72' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
69' Cristian Chivu has decided to substitute Luis Henrique and he is replaced by Andy Diouf (Inter).
69' The referee signals a substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) is brought on as a substitute for Marcus Thuram.
67' Lecce are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
66' Lameck Banda (Lecce) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
63' Oumar Ngom (Lecce) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
62' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Inter was in an offside position.
60' Here's the change. Stefan de Vrij leaves the pitch and Manuel Akanji (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Petar Sucic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter).
60' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Riccardo Sottil will be replaced by Lameck Banda (Lecce).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Omri Gandelman leaves the pitch and Oumar Ngom (Lecce) comes on.
59' Luis Henrique (Inter) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
57' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Petar Sucic (Inter) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing.
55' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) tries to find Marcus Thuram, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
53' Celebrations are cut short for Inter as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
53' Wait! Referee Gianluca Manganiello has indicated he is going to review the Inter goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
51' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.
50' A cross from a corner kick by Inter is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
48' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.

48' Marcus Thuram (Inter) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
47' One of the players from Lecce times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Gianluca Manganiello interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
43' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:4.
42' Federico Dimarco (Inter) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
41' Lecce are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

39' Davide Frattesi (Inter) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
36' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

36' What a save from Wladimiro Falcone! Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out. The referee blows his whistle, Inter are awarded a corner kick.
33' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
32' Dangerous play by Marcus Thuram (Inter). Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Petar Sucic (Inter) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
30' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Alessandro Bastoni (Inter). The linesman signals a throw-in for Inter.
27' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

26' Wladimiro Falcone makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the goal. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Inter.
24' Lecce are ruled offside.
24' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
23' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
22' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

21' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Inter force a corner. They send men into the box.
20' The possession of the ball – 30:70.

18' Marcus Thuram (Inter) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
18' A free kick on the edge of the box for Inter. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
17' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gianluca Manganiello had an easy-decision to make.
14' Inter keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
11' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
10' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Stefan de Vrij (Inter) was quite harsh and Gianluca Manganiello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
10' Luis Henrique (Inter) controls a nice lofted pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but his attempt only went low to the middle of the goal, so Wladimiro Falcone stops it easily.
7' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the right post.
7' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
4' Kialonda Gaspar is being substituted because of an injury. Eusebio Di Francesco sends Jamil Siebert (Lecce) on the pitch.
3' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
2' The game is interrupted now, Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
1' What a great touch by Marcus Thuram (Inter) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Inter will kick the game off.
Gianluca Manganiello will referee today's match.
